# Luci Playback

> A free local browser player for Luci screen-memory frames and audio.

Luci Playback plays the frames and audio that Luci saved on your computer. Open https://luci.luisliuchao.com, choose your Luci folder, and play in the browser. Files stay on this computer and are never uploaded.

Luci is the original local screen-memory app from Memories.ai. Luci Playback is an independent player for those local files.

## Links

- Site: https://luci.luisliuchao.com/
- About: https://luci.luisliuchao.com/about.html
- Full description: https://luci.luisliuchao.com/llms-full.txt
- Luci: https://luci.memories.ai
- Source: https://github.com/luisliuchao/luci-playback
- Contact: mailto:luisliuchao@gmail.com

## How it works

- Choose `~/.luciMicrosoft` on a Mac, or `~/.luci` on Linux or Windows. Do not pick the user folder.
- Encrypted `LUCISS01` frames are decrypted in the browser with the Luci Safe Storage password.
- The password never leaves this computer. This browser keeps the unlock so you can refresh.
- Playback follows real capture time. Audio plays in sync when the Luci folder has recordings.
